transcript.content: Hi, it's good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Um… I guess what brings me in is that my body hasn’t really felt like it’s totally under my control. I don’t want to make it sound dramatic, but for a while I was pacing around my apartment all night, making all these supper-club notes, like I couldn’t just sit down.

And lately it’s kind of gone the other way. I’m really slowed down… my sister says it takes me forever just to get my shoes on. I know that probably sounds odd, but it’s been noticeable enough that I thought I should talk to someone.
Have you been hearing voices when no one else is around?
No… I don’t think so. I mean, not like someone talking to me when nobody’s there. I haven’t noticed anything like that, at least. Is that what you mean?
Have you been feeling depressed lately?

I’m… not totally sure how to answer that. I mean, I’ve been feeling pretty low and slowed down, I guess, but I don’t want to overstate it. It’s not like I’m trying to be difficult or anything. I just haven’t felt like myself lately, if that counts?
Have you had a time when your mood felt unusually high or irritable?

Yeah… I think so. I mean, after I got fired, I didn’t react the way I probably should’ve. I felt almost… excited? Like weirdly unstoppable, like maybe this was actually the start of something big.

I don’t want to make it sound like I was just being awful, but if someone questioned what I was doing or told me to slow down, I’d get really mad. Like, blow up at them because it felt like they were trying to ruin my life or take something away from me. Does that make sense?
During that time when you felt unusually excited and unstoppable, did you have beliefs that other people said were clearly not true or unrealistic?

Um… yeah, I guess some people would probably say it was unrealistic. At the time it didn’t feel that way, though. I really believed I was about to build, like, the best bilingual supper club in the city, and that investors would be stupid not to get behind it.

I know that sounds kind of embarrassing now, because I didn’t even have a job then, and I didn’t really have the money lined up or anything. But in my head it felt completely obvious, like everyone else just wasn’t seeing it yet.
When you’ve been feeling slowed down and low lately, have you also believed things that other people said weren’t true?

I don’t think so… not in that same kind of way. I mean, I’ve had some pretty negative thoughts about myself, but I don’t know that I believed anything people were telling me was flat-out not true.

If you mean like being convinced of something unreal, I haven’t really noticed that lately. At least… I don’t think so. Is that the kind of thing you mean?
Right now, do you believe you deserve to be punished for something you’ve done?

I don’t think so… not like that. I mean, I feel bad about some things, and I can be pretty hard on myself, but I wouldn’t say I believe I deserve to be punished.

Unless you mean something more specific? I’m trying to answer it the right way.
While you’ve been feeling slowed down and low lately, have you felt certain that other people were watching you or trying to harm you?

No… I don’t think so. I mean, when I’m really low I can feel kind of self-conscious, like people can tell I’m not doing well, but I wouldn’t say I’ve felt certain anyone was watching me or trying to hurt me.

That would be more… like being sure of it, right? I don’t think I’ve had that.
